findings.title: specFixerNeedsFixForward routes exempt types to TEST_CASE_GEN, violating the test-case-gen bypass invariant
findings.rationale: specFixerForwardsToImplementer was deleted as part of D1, which correctly collapsed the observation path (spec-review approved → spec-fixer) into specFixerObservationForward. However, the needs-fix path (spec-review needs-fix → spec-fixer → approved) lost its exempt-type guard. specFixerNeedsFixForward returns true for all types when spec-review was needs-fix, so an exempt type (chore) in this path now routes to TEST_CASE_GEN instead of falling through to the SPEC_REVIEW fallback. This contradicts design D1: 'exempt type の観測挙動(test-case-gen を通らない・bite-evidence を通らない)は不変'. Fix: add `&& !isTestGenExempt(state)` to specFixerNeedsFixForward and add a test: chore + spec-review needs-fix + spec-fixer approved → SPEC_REVIEW (not TEST_CASE_GEN).

findings.title: evaluateTestCoverage doc comment references a non-existent implementer output contract
findings.rationale: The JSDoc on evaluateTestCoverage lists 'implementer output contract (LocalRuntime.validateStepOutputs "test-coverage" branch)' as a caller. Design D2 explicitly decided against adding a test-coverage output contract to implementer. implementer.ts outputContracts() returns only tasks-complete. The second bullet should be removed to avoid misleading future readers about the contract topology.

observations.title: TC-004 covers observation path only; needs-fix path for exempt type has no test
observations.rationale: TC-004 tests chore + spec-review approved → spec-fixer → implementer (observation path). No test covers chore + spec-review needs-fix → spec-fixer → approved. A new test is needed as part of the fix for Finding 1.
